title: Quantum Otto engine with field-decoupled idle levels in a non-Hermitian XY model
summary: We propose a microscopic realization of the idle-level quantum heat engine architecture based on a two-qubit non-Hermitian XY model with a staggered imaginary magnetic field. The energy spectrum naturally separates into two working levels coupled to the external field and two field-decoupled idle levels entirely independent of it. Tuning the non-Hermitian parameter drives the system from a dissipative accelerator regime into a genuine heat engine regime, while simultaneously enhancing both the net work output and the cycle efficiency.
